title: Letter Nov 13 1935 re political meetings, anniversaries etc

page_data.en:
COPY

November 13, 1935.

Confidential.

Deputy Commissioner (Divisions)
Deputy Commissioner (Crime)
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

Political meetings, anniversaries, etc.

Reference the above. The City Government have
requested the Secretary-General to make every effort
to suppress all such meetings and celebrations which
might in any way lead to an aggravation of Sino-Japanese
relations. They say that they will back any action we
take with this object in view and the Secretary-General
requests that no such meeting or celebration be permitted
within Settlement limits which can in any conceivable way
aggravate our present difficulties.

Please arrange accordingly.

(sd.) K. M. Bourne
Acting Commissioner of Police.

S. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 & C.S. 6.

Please instruct your staff to report as early as
possible any information coming to their attention about
plans to arrange meetings or other activities which may
have the effect mentioned.

Deputy Commissioner (Sp.Br.)

November 13, 1935.
page_data.zh:
副本

1935年11月13日。

机密。

副总巡（分区）
副总巡（刑事）
副总巡（特别处）。

政治集会、纪念日等。

关于上述事项。市政府已要求秘书长竭尽全力取缔所有可能导致中日关系恶化的此类集会和庆祝活动。他们表示，将支持我们为此目的采取的任何行动，秘书长请求不得在租界范围内允许任何可能以任何可设想的方式加剧我们当前困难的此类集会或庆祝活动。

请据此安排。

（签名）K. M. Bourne
代理警务处处长。

S. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 及 C.S. 6。

请指示你们的人员，尽早报告他们所获悉的关于计划举行可能产生上述影响的集会或其他活动的任何信息。

副总巡（特别处）

1935年11月13日。
